description: Match ONLY the pre-existing outer missing-corner notch of the whole board to the right inner notch corner of B under a half-turn. Source rays from (14,8) point down/blue and right/red; B rays from (8,1) point up/blue and left/red. This is real local boundary compatibility, falsely generalized to three-copy global tileability.
